2026-07-09 Korea

Korea Day 6

Breakfast

If you read the previous posts, you know where I went today, lol. It's been good to also call Rachel during breakfast and catch up with each other.

Tim Hortons

I took the chance to go to the nearby Tim Hortons. I was curious to see if it was similar to the ones in Canada.

Canadian Lobster Roll?
Hockey stick door handles. Nice touch!
They definitely have more fruity drinks

Olive Young

I went to Olive Young to get some skincare products for the fam. You can't walk more than 2 blocks without seeing one of these stores. Korea's beauty industry is no joke.

IMC Chess Puzzles

I tried my luck at the puzzles again for a chance to get their prize. I did better this time but so did everyone else, lol. I went early so temporarily I was first for the day.

Lunch

Had the Korean version of Katsu Curry. It was ok. I grew to like it more as I kept eating. I'm excited to have it in Japan and compare.

Posters

More good conversations about papers. Unfortunately there is only finite time to go over them. My brain was fried at the end of the day. There is always a wide range of poster styles: from the structured university templates, to very artsy posters, to those putting animes/memes in a sensical/non-sensical way.

Memes, lol

Dinner

Had dinner with coworkers after the last session. Food was great.

Had soju, makgeolli (rice wine), and a chestnut makgeolli. Makgeolli is dangerously good and easy to drink.
Terrible photo, but we had some egg and potato pancakes

Dessert

If the above wasn't enough (which it was), we went for dessert. We had mango and red bean bingsu (shaved ice with milk/cream).
